label: Late-episode D2 after choosing a2 again, following an unrewarded (mostly rare) previous trial
explanation: Fires only at D2 (100% of mass), only when the action just taken is a2 (in_action == 2), almost only when the previous trial was unrewarded (99.7% of mass), and only late in the episode (ep_trial >= ~70, 77% of mass at trials 90-99). It strongly prefers that the previous trial was a rare transition (prev_common == 0: 81% of mass, lift 3.1x; prev_common == -1 means the previous trial lies outside the window). So in practice: the agent chose a2, the previous a2 choice went rare to S1 and was not rewarded, and the agent repeated a2 (the model-based stay after rare-unrewarded). In top examples the peak (1.0) comes when the current trial then goes common to S2; when the current trial goes rare to S1 activation is about 0.4. Activity is concentrated where value is low and the policy logit favors a2. It never fires at D1 or GO, after a1, or after a rewarded trial. Without the rare condition (D2 & a2 & prev unrewarded & late) recall is 0.96 but precision is 0.46. Every variable used is observed at D2 (ep_trial stands in for elapsed time in the episode). Dev: P 0.72, R 0.82, F1 0.77, mass recall 0.95.
